queries.get_lifetime_exclusive_savings:
SELECT IFNULL(round(sum((pap.price * hp.qty) - hp.price ),0),0) as exclusive_savings
            FROM users u
            LEFT JOIN  orders o on o.order_status not in (0, 4, 7, 10, 17, 22)  AND  u.id = o.user_id
            LEFT JOIN has_products hp ON o.id = hp.order_id
            LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = (CASE WHEN hp.sub_prod_id>0 THEN hp.sub_prod_id ELSE hp.prod_id END)
            LEFT JOIN products pap ON pap.id = (CASE WHEN p.parent_prod_id>0 THEN p.parent_prod_id ELSE p.id END)
            WHERE u.id in (7) GROUP BY u.id;
queries.get_last_orders:
SELECT
                                COUNT(oo.id)
                            FROM
                                orders oo
                            WHERE
                                oo.user_id = 7
                                AND oo.order_status NOT IN (0 , 17)
                                AND oo.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
queries.get_total_orders:
SELECT
                                COUNT(os.id) AS TotalStoreOrder,
                                COUNT(o.id) AS TotalOrder
                            FROM
                                orders o
                                    LEFT JOIN
                                order_stores os ON os.order_id = o.id
                            WHERE
                                o.order_status NOT IN (0 , 17)
                                    AND o.user_id = 7
queries.get_nps_score:
SELECT
                        AVG(feedback_answer) as NPS
                    FROM
                        nps_feedback nf
                            LEFT JOIN
                        orders o ON o.id = nf.order_id
                    WHERE
                        o.user_id = 7
